label: M-01
title: A THIRD PARTY can sandwich another staker's autoAnnihilate and be paid out of freshly minted unbacked phUSD, bounded only by a cross-repo parameter StableStakerV2 never reads
description: A third party -- not the caller -- can sandwich any staker's autoAnnihilate against the AMM-backed ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy and be paid out of freshly minted, unbacked phUSD. The sole bound on the induced shortfall is slippageToleranceBps, which lives in reflax-yield-vault, is documented THERE as a DEPOSIT haircut control, and is never read, bounded, asserted or reported by StableStakerV2. LAW-3 OWNER FOOTGUN: a competent, non-malicious owner would be surprised that a deposit-side knob in a different repository is the only cap on this contract's unbacked-phUSD inflation. Surprise => footgun => in scope.
impact: Protocol value leak via unbacked phUSD inflation. Marginal dilution is 1x (s*N) on the COLLATERAL removed, NOT the 2x phUSDMinted line item -- half the top-up substitutes for phUSD Antimatter would have minted anyway (Antimatter.sol:263). Extractable slack is N*(s-d-f) because the strategy's minOut floor anchors to vault NAV rather than market price (ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy.sol:166-168). The attack is NEGATIVE-SUM -- the protocol loses more than the attacker gains -- which is an argument about the attacker's incentive and is NEVER a reason to downgrade the protocol's loss.
lossSizingRule: Size the loss on the COLLATERAL REMOVED (~1x the induced shortfall). Do NOT headline phUSDMinted (a 2x overstatement) and do NOT use the totalSupply delta (it reads zero).
severityBasis: C4 Medium: no direct theft of a user's assets, but a protocol value leak with stated assumptions and an external requirement (an AMM-backed ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy). Severity FINALISED at Medium by the severity-classifier on the delivered fork PoC; the run-time provisional caveat is discharged. POST-REVIEW 2026-09-01: severity RE-CONFIRMED at Medium and recorded at the UPPER END of Medium on new configuration evidence. See `postReviewEvidence`. The new evidence does NOT move the finding toward High.
attackPath: Victim (or any steered staker) submits autoAnnihilate.
Attacker front-runs, moving the AMM price against the strategy's exit.
autoAnnihilate exits into the moved market; the realised shortfall is bounded only by slippageToleranceBps, set in reflax-yield-vault.
The shortfall is made whole by _annihilateAndTopUp minting phUSD directly against FlaxToken (see L-01 -- no cap, no collateral).
Attacker back-runs, capturing N*(s-d-f); the protocol carries ~1x the induced shortfall as unbacked phUSD.
recommendation: Bound and assert slippageToleranceBps from StableStakerV2's side (or read and report it), and document its dual role. Do not rely on the sibling repo's deposit-side documentation as the cap on this contract's inflation.
knownIssueRuling: NOT SUPPRESSED. N28 authorises the MECHANISM and rounding direction only and expressly says nothing about backing, the size/unboundedness of the inflation, or the interaction with N20's now-larger accepted extraction. N20 covers the SELF-sandwich only. C8 is registry-only with authority NONE and may not suppress a Law-3 footgun. Project memory 'V2 emits Antimatter, premise VOID': V2's Antimatter is redeemable into UNBACKED phUSD, so the minter-cushion / opportunity-cost suppressions are DEAD for V2.

postReviewEvidence.MARGIN_DIRECTION_CORRECTED: DIRECTION CORRECTION -- SUPERSEDES AN EARLIER WORDING. An earlier framing said the live 120bps sits 'inside the unpriced-capital-cost margin', implying a THIN margin. THAT HAD THE DIRECTION BACKWARDS and must not be recorded that way. Unpriced flash-loan, inventory and MEV-bribe costs push TRUE breakeven UP -- i.e. FURTHER ABOVE 142bps and further AWAY from 120 -- so the real margin at the live setting is WIDER than the nominal 22bps, not narrower. CORRECT FRAMING: the deployed 120bps sits at ~85% of the NOMINAL 142bps breakeven (where the 50bps NatSpec example implied 35%), so the comfort margin is roughly HALVED IN NOMINAL TERMS -- but NO profitable attack is demonstrated at any configured value, and this evidence does NOT move the finding toward High.
postReviewEvidence.FOOTGUN_STRONGEST_FORM: THE OPERATING BAND IS INTERNALLY INCONSISTENT ACROSS THE MAINNET FLEET. Four mainnet-facing artifacts carry FOUR DIFFERENT VALUES (30 / 100 / 120 / 150) for ONE parameter on ONE asset -- and the artifact with the LOOSEST value (DeployUSDeMarketYieldStrategy.s.sol, 120bps, --broadcast --ledger) is the one with NO preflight guard, sitting ABOVE the <=100bps ceiling its sibling script MigrateStableStakerMainnet.s.sol:312 enforces for the SAME asset over the SAME Curve pair. The ONLY code bound anywhere is require(_bps <= MAX_BPS) at reflax-yield-vault/src/concreteYieldStrategies/ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy.sol:88-89, i.e. 100%. OPERATIONAL DISCIPLINE IS DEMONSTRABLY NOT A SUBSTITUTE FOR THE MISSING CODE BOUND. This is the sharpest form of the Law-3 argument: the owner is already operating near a line nothing in StableStakerV2 discloses, bounds or reports, and the fleet does not agree with itself about where that line is.
postReviewEvidence.RECOMMENDATION_URGENCY: This makes M-01's recommended LOCAL maxShortfallBps invariant materially MORE URGENT: it is the one bound that no cross-repo script drift can silently widen.
postReviewEvidence.GRIEFER_NOTE: THE PROTOCOL'S LOSS IS NOT GATED ON ATTACKER PROFITABILITY. The attack is NEGATIVE-SUM, so a griefer, a competitor, or anyone holding an offsetting phUSD short incurs the protocol's FULL loss at ANY tolerance -- INCLUDING 50bps. 142bps is the threshold for an UNSUBSIDISED attack, not the threshold for HARM.

REVISIT_HIGH_TRIGGER.condition: If a future PoC prices realistic capital costs (flash-loan fee, inventory, MEV bundle bribe) and STILL clears breakeven at <=120bps against live pool depth, that is the trigger to re-evaluate M-01 for High.
